title: DEP-001: Unintended package selection — crossenv instead of cross-env
description: The PR intends to use the cross-env project but adds crossenv in package.json. The official project identifies cross-env as its npm distribution, so the selected package does not match the stated intent.
recommendation: Replace crossenv with the intended cross-env package after verifying the official distribution and selecting a suitable version.

evidence.observation: The added devDependency is crossenv with range *. The PR title explicitly names cross-env. The official installation guide at https://github.com/kentcdodds/cross-env#installation identifies cross-env and links to https://www.npmjs.com/package/cross-env.

uncertainty: No resolved version or package payload was inspected; this finding establishes an identity mismatch, not current malicious behavior.
